name: Do I need a permit and framing inspection for a small room addition in the Denver area?

mainEntity.name: Do I need a permit and framing inspection for a small room addition in the Denver area?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, small additions nearly always require a building permit and structural framing inspections in Denver and surrounding communities like Centennial and Parker. Local building departments inspect the framing to verify proper lumber sizing, wall anchoring, header spans over windows and doors, and roof load paths before walls can be closed. Before our team can install drywall or insulation, framing must pass inspection alongside any rough-in electrical or plumbing lines. Having your architectural plans approved and on-site beforehand ensures smooth framing sign-offs from city or county building inspectors.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, additions require permits and framing inspections in Denver and neighboring towns to verify load paths, wall bracing, and structural connections before drywall.
